scope: UBIPr, single original photo per query; no cross-query or temporal fusion; validation development only
method: Frozen previous encoders. RGB same-photo rotations -10,0,+10 degrees bilinear black fill; polar same-photo angular rolls -32,-16,0,+16,+32 columns. Mean normalized vectors then L2 per original photo. Apply to all gallery and query images.
variants: RGB TTA top3, polar TTA top3, fixed thirds RGB-TTA/polar-TTA/previous spatial; same fusion with predefined per-query normalization
calibration: Per-variant validation empirical FMR<=1%; fusion validation impostor z-score, no weight search; validation repeatedly used
failures: All482 queries retained; require all fusion components valid
